name: eve
note: Markdown instructions, TS tools, one folder
summary: An open-source, filesystem-first agent framework from Vercel, launched in public preview in June 2026. An agent is a directory: instructions.md holds the system prompt, tools/ holds typed TypeScript tools, and skills, channels, schedules and subagents live in their own folders. Each conversation runs as a durable workflow and agent code runs in an isolated sandbox.
facts: Vercel Sandbox deployed; Docker, microsandbox or just-bash locally
